fileFindings.title: a credential exists in git history
fileFindings.why: a key deleted in the next commit is still a key: anyone who can clone can read it. Rotate it — rewriting history does not un-leak it

fileFindings.title: the image runs as root
fileFindings.why: a container escape starts as root, and nothing in this file says that was a decision

fileFindings.title: `COPY . .` with no .dockerignore
fileFindings.why: the whole working tree goes into the image — including .env, .git, and whatever else is lying around
